known_facts_at_decision_date: Kingfisher Airlines had never turned a profit since its launch
By 5 October 2012 the airline had grounded its entire fleet
Employees were seven months behind on salary payments
Aviation regulator DGCA was seeking legal opinion on cancelling Kingfisher's operating licence
Accumulated losses at end of FY2011-12 exceeded 50% of net worth
Cash losses occurred during FY2011-12 and the preceding financial year
FY2011-12 domestic revenue declined from ₹47,731 million (FY2010-11) to ₹41,126 million
FY2011-12 income from services was ₹54,935 million
Problem combined severe cash shortage, salary arrears, grounded operations, regulatory risk, debt pressure, and poor unit economics
